ratings.rationale: Landmark HFrEF trial directly informing SGLT2 inhibitor use in heart failure.
ratings.evidence_basis: Large randomized clinical-outcome trial with patient-centered endpoints.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: Restricted HFrEF enrollment limits broader HF phenotypes.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: Would fall only for a narrower clinical question unrelated to HFrEF.

ratings.rationale: Established SGLT2 inhibition as effective HFrEF therapy irrespective of diabetes status.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: Later trials extend the class and EF spectrum.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: Historical novelty remains high; contemporary novelty is lower after confirmatory studies.

ratings.rationale: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled event-driven design with adjudication and prespecified hierarchy.
ratings.evidence_basis: Protocol/SAP, ITT analysis, independent replication of sponsor analyses.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: Sponsor involvement and some subgroup/post hoc analyses outside confirmatory hierarchy.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: Independent replication and longer follow-up reinforce confidence; major protocol deviations would lower it.

ratings.rationale: Primary and key secondary clinical outcomes show precise, internally consistent treatment effects.
ratings.evidence_basis: Primary HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.65-0.85); robust event counts and consistent components.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: Renal endpoint was underpowered/non-significant; subgroup comparisons are less precise.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: Replication across independent HFrEF trials would raise already-high confidence.

ratings.rationale: Multinational trial with standard background HFrEF therapy and diabetes/no-diabetes participants.
ratings.evidence_basis: 410 centers in 20 countries, broad symptomatic HFrEF population.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: eGFR <30 excluded, Black participants <5%, few very elderly multimorbid patients, low baseline ARNI use.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: More diverse enrollment and contemporary background therapy would raise applicability.

ratings.rationale: Regimen is simple and effect size is clinically interpretable.
ratings.evidence_basis: Dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily; NNT 21 over median 18.2 months; low incremental BP effect.
ratings.principal_limiting_factor: Eligibility and renal/volume-status monitoring still matter.
ratings.what_would_raise_or_lower: Implementation value is already high for eligible HFrEF populations.
